en: Black-and-white postcard showing a paved square in front of a grand 19th‑century building with arched windows and an ornate central pediment. In the middle stands a monument with a winged female figure on a tall pedestal, surrounded by steps and lampposts. Tree‑lined paths extend to the right where people in early 20th‑century clothing stroll. A printed caption appears along the lower margin.
